ui_bugs.issue: Inline className is bg-[#FFFFFF] (computed backgroundColor rgb(255,255,255) = pure white), but the review request specified 'ai-float-btn (now glass-blue)'. Visually it reads as light blue because of the .pulse-glow shadow ring (rgba(125,211,252,0.45)), and clicking it does open the AI chat panel correctly. This is a minor cosmetic deviation only — the button is white, not glass-blue. Recommend changing to bg-[#7DD3FC] or .glass + light-blue tint to match the spec.

rca of the issue: AI float button styling RCA: the AIChatWidget JSX uses className 'bg-[#FFFFFF]' (white background) directly on the floating button. The .pulse-glow keyframe (defined in index.css as pulse-blue) adds a light-blue box-shadow halo around it, which is why the button reads visually as light blue in screenshots, but the actual fill is white. To match the iter-4 'glass-blue' spec, change the class to bg-[#7DD3FC] (solid) or to .glass + a light-blue tinted overlay. No functional impact — the button is clickable, opens the chat panel, and the panel shows agent modes correctly.
